title: Bigelow tells Fox 'they're walking among us'

tellings.quote: And then he goes he goes, "Uh, yeah, and they're walking among us."

plain: In Las Vegas in 2009, a man Fox names as Bigelow is said to have told him plainly that non-human beings are already here: "Uh, yeah, and they're walking among us." James Fox, who says he heard it himself, tells Michels the story and links it to his film I Know What I Saw. If true, someone close to the subject was saying outright that visitors live unseen among people.
